title: Lever's public postings API: what one request returns, and five things to handle
summary:
Every Lever job board is also a public JSON API. Lever publishes it so that a company's jobs can be shown anywhere; it needs no key for reading. One request per company returns the whole board. We built a search on it this autumn; this is what the API gives you, measured on 16 November 2026 on three boards, Palantir (302 open jobs), Zoox (241) and Spotify (87), and on our daily index of 32,410 Lever jobs on 345 boards.

One URL per company 

https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/<board>?mode=json

<board> is the company's board name, the same word that appears in its job links (jobs.lever.co/spotify/...). A board name that does not exist returns HTTP 404 with {"ok":false,"error":"Document not found"}, so a typo fails loudly. Boards hosted in Europe (jobs.eu.lever.co, 66 of the 347 in our index)

title: How AI Video Generation Works
summary:
Developer note: Series 3, Episode 5 deep dive for Paragon AI MAG. How does AI video generation work? The mechanism: a diffusion transformer (DiT) denoises latent representations — video compressed into latent space, chopped into 3D spacetime patches that act like text tokens, denoised over 20 to 50 passes with text conditioning, native audio generated in the same pass as the pixels. We also cover why clips stay under 30 seconds (compute grows with every frame, small errors compound into physical drift), the 2026 leaders (Veo 3.1, Kling 4, Seedance 2.5, Runway Gen-4.5), Veo 3.1 API rates and Flow credits, and the 6-element prompt formula. title: Cloudflare doesn't cache your HTML. Cache Rules, explained without the dashboard tour
summary:
You put a site behind Cloudflare, send Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=300 on your pages, and every HTML response still says cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC. Nothing is misconfigured. Cloudflare just never looked at your header.

Its default cache behaviour page says it directly: "Cloudflare only caches based on file extension and not by MIME type. The Cloudflare CDN does not cache HTML or JSON by default." Your s-maxage is only read after something has made the request eligible, and for HTML that something is a Cache Rule.

Here's how the pieces fit, checked against Cloudflare's docs and two live sites today.

What cf-cache-status is telling you

The statuses split into two groups, and the split matters more than any single value.

title: Startup.jobs Salary Filters in Python: Overlap Does Not Prove a Pay Floor
summary:
Your recommender sets minSalaryUsd, then confidently recommends a listing whose published range starts below the user's minimum. The filter can be working correctly. That's the uncomfortable part.

Lab note 116: can we turn salary-filtered job records into recommendations that support an annual minimum? Our bet: the model needs less listing text and a stricter decision made before the prompt.

The catch comes first: published pay supports a statement about a listing, never a guaranteed offer. Even that narrower statement needs compatible pay periods.

What does the salary filter actually promise?

The salary filters select overlapping published ranges, not ranges contained within your requested bounds.
